title: Intersection of Two Linked Lists
problemStatement: Two singly linked lists may intersect at a common node. Given the heads of both linked lists, determine the node where they intersect. If they do not intersect, return null.
input: Two linked lists. The testing system may internally create an intersection.
output: The value of the intersection node, or null if there is no intersection.
constraints: Number of nodes in both lists is in the range [0, 10^5].
